newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Union says Randgold plans layoffs.
newsitem.headline: Union says Randgold plans layoffs.

text.p: The National Union of Mineworkers said on Wednesday that Randgold & Exploration Company Ltd planned to retrench 1,000 workers at Grootvlei Proprietary Mines by the end of January.
A Randgold spokeswoman told Reuters, however, that no final decision had been taken on any layoffs.
She said the union's statement related to the possible closure of "L" shaft at the East Rand Proprietary Mines Ltd (ERPM).
"It has been under discussion...A final decision will be taken on Monday (January 13)," she said, adding that no further details were available at this stage.
Both ERPM and Grootvlei are controlled by Randgold.
ERPM posted pre-capex profit of 15.02 million rand in the quarter to September 30 1996, while Grootvlei posted a pre-capex loss of 4.09 million rand in the same period.
Randgold is due to report its mines' results for the quarter to December 31 on January 27.
